events.title: Jay & Eli Live — The Lenches Club
events.body: Live acoustic rock and pop duo Jay & Eli perform at The Lenches Club on Saturday 26 September from 8.30pm. All welcome for an evening of live music.

image.alt: Black and white promotional photo of musical duo Jay & Eli

events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Cash bingo night at The Lenches Club on Friday 2 October. Ticket sales from 7.15pm, eyes down at 8pm. £5 per book, £5 cash flyer, bonus ball £1 per square, cash only, over 18s only.

image.alt: Poster for cash bingo night with pink and green striped border and ticket details

events.title: Peter Pandemonium by GLADS — The Lenches Club
events.body: GLADS present their pirate-themed show Peter Pandemonium at The Lenches Club on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 October, starting at 7.30pm. Tickets £10 per person, available at the bar or from any GLADS member.

image.alt: AI-generated poster for GLADS production Peter Pandemonium featuring pirates and a mermaid

news.title: New Website and Board Update — The Lenches Club
news.body: The Lenches Club has launched a members' website (www.thelenchesclub.co.uk) for checking membership and renewals, booking the club, and seeing what's on. The letter also introduces new board members following recent departures.

news.title: Season Finale Thanks — The Lenches Amphitheatre
news.body: The Lenches Amphitheatre's 2026 season has closed, ending with Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Governor's Nose. The volunteer-run charity thanks supporters, performers and donors, and is now planning its 2027 programme.

image.alt: Collage of photos from The Lenches Amphitheatre season, including performers, audiences and volunteers

notices.title: Road Closure — Evesham Road, Church Lench
notices.body: Evesham Road in Church Lench will be closed on Tuesday 29 September for streetworks, with a signed diversion route in place. Delays likely for local traffic.

notices.title: Roadworks — Radford Road, Rous Lench
notices.body: Openreach works on Radford Road, Rous Lench from Tuesday 29 September to Thursday 1 October, with multi-way traffic signals in place. Delays possible for road users.

notices.title: Roadworks — Hipton Hill, Lenchwick
notices.body: Openreach roadworks will close Hipton Hill, Lenchwick on Tuesday 29 September. Delays are likely; drivers should plan alternative routes.

notices.title: Roadworks — Evesham Road, Inkberrow
notices.body: Openreach traffic signals will be in place on Evesham Road, Inkberrow from Wednesday 30 September to Friday 2 October, with possible delays for road users.

notices.title: Roadworks — Gooms Hill, Abbots Morton
notices.body: Two phases of roadworks are planned on Gooms Hill, Abbots Morton: Severn Trent Water on 24 September and Openreach from 29 September to 1 October, both using two-way traffic signals.
